title: Onboarding pathways and intervention playbook for premier pilots
creator: Aria Chen
description:
Purpose: Operationalize a two-track onboarding model (Self-Serve + Concierge) for our premier pilot cohort and define an intervention playbook that triggers timely product, documentation, and support actions. This ticket coordinates release-note responsibilities, cross-team comms, and quantitative gates that determine when an intervention (engineering/solutions) is required.

Scope: This work covers the first 8 weeks of a pilot engagement: signup to initial integration verification, first production inference run, and the 14-day success window. This ticket does not cover long-term account expansion or Dedicated provisioning workflows.

Objectives:
- Reduce time-to-first-successful-inference for pilot accounts to <= 48 hours (median).
- Surface quality and performance regressions to PM/Eng within 24 hours of pilot impact events.
- Ensure release notes and migration guidance are delivered to pilot admins before any model or runtime change that might affect output quality or API compatibility.

Stakeholders:
- PM lead: Nina Patel (assignee)
- Solutions & SE: Diego Morales
- Eng owners: ENG-4821 (runtime) and ENG-4975 (api)
- Design: DES-332 (onboarding flows)
- Docs/Comms: Priya Rao (developer docs & release notes)
- Support/SRE: Maya Lin

Success criteria (launch gates):
1) Activation velocity: median time from account creation to first successful POST /v1/completions <= 48 hours for 75% of pilot cohort.
2) Retention: 14-day active usage (>= 1 inference/day) for at least 60% of pilot seats enrolled.
3) Quality SLO: no more than 5% of pilot requests flagged with quality regressions (eval set) in the first 14 days.
4) Support SLA: triage acknowledgement by on-call within 2 hours for high-severity pilot incidents.

Onboarding pathways (two-track):
- Self-Serve Path: quickstart template, pre-filled API key perms, a short runbook (2-3 steps) that verifies connectivity, token limits, and sample generation. Target: 30–45 minutes for an engineer to verify. Docs owner: Priya Rao.
- Concierge Path: Assign an SE for account setup and run a 60–90 minute kickoff; run an integration checklist with the customer including model selection, latency expectations, and telemetry hooks. SE owner: Diego Morales.

Intervention triggers & playbooks (automated + manual):
- Trigger A (Automated): activation_time > 72 hours -> send automated escalation to PM + SE; schedule 30-min sync.
- Trigger B (Automated): API error rate > 1% sustained over 1 hour for pilot project -> pager to runtime on-call, PM notification, temporary routing to fallback variant.
- Trigger C (Manual): customer reports hallucination or quality complaint on core demo prompts -> run quick eval against regression suite, compare to baseline, and if delta > threshold, open ENG rollback/mitigation.
- Playbook contents: required logs and artifacts (request/response samples, eval IDs, token counts, routing rules used), owner for each step, expected ETA for resolution.

Telemetry & dashboards to build (metrics to track):
- Activation_time_ms (time from signup to first successful inference)
- First_success_event (boolean) and timestamp
- Daily_active_tokens and requests per pilot-account
- API_error_rate (4xx/5xx) and tail latency (p95/p99) per model variant
- Quality_regression_flag per eval-run (link to eval run id)
Dashboards owner: Console team (add route-level filter for pilot_accounts tag).

Release notes coordination:
- Any runtime, model, or API change tagged as impacting "pilot_accounts" must have a release note stub 72 hours before the change. Docs owner to coordinate with ENG release manager to confirm wording and mitigation steps.
- Release note template: summary, impact, mitigation, rollback steps, contact for pilot SE.
- For breaking compatibility, we require a 10-business-day notice and confirmation of pilot-staged rollout.

Communications plan:
- Weekly pilot syncs (PM + SE + customer success + SRE) during first 4 weeks; then biweekly.
- Monthly status digest to pilot stakeholders summarizing activation metrics, open issues, and planned changes.
- Immediate incident bulletin for any degradation affecting >10% of pilot traffic.

Tasks & owners (high level):
- Build pilot onboarding quickstart (Docs): Priya Rao (due 2026-03-01)
- Implement activation telemetry (Eng): ENG-4821 (due 2026-03-08)
- Dashboard filters and alerting (Console): Console team (due 2026-03-05)
- Release note workflow update (PM + Docs + Eng): Nina Patel + Priya Rao (due 2026-03-04)
- Concierge playbook runbook (SE): Diego Morales (due 2026-03-10)

Timeline (milestones):
- 2026-03-01: Quickstart & release-note template ready
- 2026-03-05: Dashboard & alerting in staging
- 2026-03-08: Telemetry instrumented in runtime for pilot flag
- 2026-03-12: First pilot cohort invited (soft launch)
- 2026-03-31: Pilot 30-day checkpoint and go/no-go review

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Delayed telemetry rollout prevents automated triggers. Mitigation: manual sampling and extra SE runs until telemetry ships.
- Risk: Release changes cause quality regressions. Mitigation: require canary on pilot flag and rollback decision tree.

Open questions:
- Do we want to limit pilot accounts to a single region initially to simplify routing? (suggestion: NA only for first cohort)
- Should concierge onboarding include a short performance SLA in writing?

Next steps:
- Confirm owners for each dashboard row by 2026-02-26.
- Draft release-note templates and circulate for review by Docs + Eng by 2026-02-25.
